title: Rosalind and the Asset
author: Gideon Vasquez
blurb: Ines Vasquez, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
